description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class (ClippingBasicFragment) for an Android application demonstrating how to clip a View using an Outline. It includes methods for setting up the UI, handling user interactions (button clicks to toggle clipping and text view clicks to change displayed text), and a custom ViewOutlineProvider implementation that defines a rounded rectangle outline inset by 10%.

classes.name: ClippingBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that demonstrates clipping a View with an Outline and toggling clip on button press.

classes.name: ClippingBasicFragment.ClipOutlineProvider
classes.description: A custom ViewOutlineProvider that applies a rounded rectangle outline inset by 10% of the View's dimensions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up the outline provider, and loads sample texts.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the UI elements, binds event handlers for clipping toggle and text change.

methods.name: changeText
methods.description: Updates the TextView with the next sample text based on click count.

methods.name: getOutline (inner class ClipOutlineProvider)
methods.description: Defines the outline shape as a rounded rectangle inset by 10%.
